description:
Locate a passage *inside* one manual, without paging through it.

        Use this after ``search_docs`` whenever you need a specific table, command
        or error code rather than the whole page — including short documents,
        because manuals commonly open with a preamble and page 1 rarely answers a
        question. It returns the exact ``offset`` of each match, so one
        ``get_doc(doc_id, offset=...)`` lands on the right section.

        Prefer this over repeatedly calling ``get_doc`` with increasing offsets.

        Args:
            doc_id: id from ``search_docs`` (also accepts the page slug).
            query: the *concept*, not the product name — e.g. "波特率" or
                "急停 接线". Terms that already appear in this page's title are
                ignored, because ``search_docs`` picked the page by them; passing
                the product name again only adds noise. Generic words that appear
                in nearly every manual are down-weighted, so one distinctive term
                is enough.
            limit: 1-10 passages, default 5.

        Matching is OR, not AND: a passage is returned when it contains at least
        one term with enough weight. Terms that are absent from this page therefore
        do **not** force a zero result — check ``missing_terms`` to see which of
        your words this page never mentions, and ``matched_terms`` for the ones it
        does. A query made only of stop words (or nothing) returns ``count: 0``
        with a hint.

        Returns JSON: {doc_id,title,space,url,chars,query,count,returned,
        matched_terms,missing_terms,hits:[{offset,heading,score,matched,excerpt}],
        hint}. ``count`` is the total number of matched passages; ``returned`` is
        how many are in ``hits`` (capped by ``limit``). ``heading`` is the nearest
        heading above the passage; ``offset`` is absolute in the page body.
name: find_in_doc
